article.title: Gaza holds funeral for 100 Palestinians recovered from rubble
article.summary: Gaza holds funeral for 100 Palestinians recovered from rubbleA funeral was held in Gaza on Saturday for around 100 Palestinians whose bodies were recovered from the rubble of homes destroyed in Israeli attacks, Reuters reported.The ceremony took place in the Zeitoun neighbourhood, southeast of Gaza City, where relatives and residents gathered to mourn the victims.According to Gaza civil defence authorities, the deceased included 55 members of the Malka family, whose remains were recovered underneath the rubble of a building in the Zeytoun area.The victims had sought refuge in the building roughly two years ago during an Israeli bombing campaign.

article.title: Israeli strikes kill seven Palestinians in Gaza in past 24 hours
article.summary: Israeli strikes kill seven Palestinians in Gaza in past 24 hoursTwo Palestinians have died from injuries sustained in Israeli attacks in the Gaza Strip, bringing the number of Palestinians killed over the past 24 hours to seven, according to the Palestinian news agency Wafa.Six-year-old Daoud Muqata was killed after being shot north of Gaza City several weeks ago, while Subhi al-Batrikhi succumbed to wounds sustained in an Israeli air attack on a group of civilians in the city’s Remal neighbourhood on Sunday.Massive explosions were heard across Gaza around dawn after Israeli air strikes hit residential buildings in Gaza City’s Tuffah neighbourhood, according to local media.Israeli jets also struck several locations overnight, including homes belonging to the al-Batsh and Habib families and the Hayfa Hospital building behind the al-Sakhra commercial complex.
